name: fey
title: Fey joined Wealthsimple
body:
Fey joined Wealthsimple. Everything we built at Fey—our technology, design philosophy, and relentless focus on clarity—is now helping shape what comes next at Wealthsimple, across investing and banking.

Fey proved that a small, independent team could raise the bar in a category that had settled for less. We built with taste, conviction, and an obsession with making finance feel simpler, smarter, and genuinely better. Now, with Wealthsimple's scale and reach, that ambition goes further.

Sign-ups to Fey are closed. But the work continues…

import React from 'react'
import { View, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native'
import { useVehicleState } from '@hooks/useVehicleState'
import { Dashboard } from '@components/Dashboard'
export const HomeScreen = () => {
  const { vehicleState, isFullySynced } = useVehicleState()
  if (!isFullySynced) {
    return <ActivityIndicator size="large" />
  }
  return (
    <View>
      <Dashboard state={vehicleState} />
    </View>
  )
}
import React from 'react'
import { View, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native'
import { useVehicleState, SyncStatus } from '@hooks/useVehicleState'
import { Dashboard } from '@components/Dashboard'
export const HomeScreen = () => {
  const { vehicleState, syncStatus } = useVehicleState()
  if (syncStatus === SyncStatus.PENDING) {
    return <ActivityIndicator size="large" />
  }
  return (
    <View>
      <Dashboard state={vehicleState} syncStatus={syncStatus} />
    </View>
  )
}

Changelog
Priority inbox
An active workspace can create a significant amount of notifications each day, and until now your inbox treated them all the same. The new Priority tab separates what needs your attention from what can wait, so something like a review blocking a release never gets buried.
SEP 3, 2026
Coding sessions
Linear Agent can now set up, run, and test your code before returning its work. That means fewer handoffs and changes that are further along when they come back to you.
AUG 19, 2026
Team initiatives
Initiatives are Linear's way to manage product strategy and high-level planning across projects. Strategy may start at the company level, but teams carry it forward. You can now assign a team to lead an initiative, making it clear who is responsible for driving the work and how it contributes to the broader direction.
AUG 13, 2026
Coding sessions on mobile
Your coding session doesn’t have to stop when you leave your desk. Use the Linear mobile app to review code changes, comment on specific lines, and iterate with Linear Agent.
